limitations: It is explicitly not official AI AgriBench.
It contains 283 unique questions and 133 duplicate-question variants.
Gold answers are local rubric summaries rather than expert-edited benchmark references.
It lacks the source-exact locator and authority contract required for successor retrieval evaluation.
assets.permitted_successor_use: failure-mode review and candidate case harvesting only after source, rights, split, and duplicate review
assets.prohibited_use: official leaderboard comparison, RC3 pooling, semantic-quality ground truth, or retriever-promotion endpoint

assets.relationship: records the proxy's deduplication and synthetic-rubric construction

disposition: Retained as a hash-bound historical candidate catalog; none of these assets is copied into the successor runtime or retrieval-promotion suite.
